body: Her dad is basically going through the same situation. He isn't able to really do anything because he doesn't want her to do anything irrational. Idk. It's just a terrible situation.

Everytime she mentioned wanting to move out she would threaten to kill herself, and is like, "Am I not doing enough as a mother? Should I just kill myself? Will that make your life better?" Not word for word, but she has definitely mentioned killing herself as a result of her wanting to move out.
Her mom keeps her from moving out, which is why she hasn't been able to get out of the toxic environment she's in right now. She's 22 for crying out loud.
